item.title: Version 1.0.22
item.description:
What's New

  • Introduced Scan as a first-class segment type with timing validation and stop-and-retry recovery
  • Single-key bursts for non-select steps — retry only resends the key that didn't land

  • Consolidated CheckpointReducer, SwitchControlRecoveryReducer, and SegmentedExecutionReducer into one unified SegmentedOperationReducer
  • Reject concurrent operations while one is already in progress
